correctness.rationale: For fixed j, leafhood independently excludes j from each later parent's choices, with probability product (j−1)/(n−1). On that event, delete j and relabel in birth order. The remaining independently uniform choices give a uniform size-(n−1) recursive tree, and no surviving depth changes. The conditioning leaves D_j's mean H_(j−1) unchanged. Since the unconditional increase in expected path length is H_(n−1), this directly verifies the conditional mean shift without assuming independence of D_j and the remaining tree. Multiplying by the event probability gives the label covariance; summing by reversing the harmonic sum gives −(n−2)/4. The adjacent differences in k=j−1 are (1+H_k−H_(n−1))/(n−1), strictly increasing; harmonic integral bounds approximate the whole profile uniformly to O(1/(n−1)) by u log u at u=k/(n−1). Its unique limiting minimum is at u=1/e. The variance constants also follow directly: if v_t=Var(P_t)/t², conditioning on the size-(t−1) tree gives v_t=(1−1/t²)v_(t−1)+Var(D_t)/t², with Var(D_t)=H_(t−1)−sum_(k<t)1/k² from the depth generating function. Iteration and changing the order of the resulting nonnegative sum give lim v_t=sum_(k≥1)(1/k−1/k²)/(k+1)=2−π²/6. The leaf count grows by one minus a conditional Bernoulli with parameter L_(t−1)/(t−1), so its variance obeys w_t=(1−2/(t−1))w_(t−1)+1/4 and yields w_t=t/12 for t≥3. Thus the correlation coefficient and domain are correct. An independent hand enumeration of the six parent pairs at n=4 gave mean 13/3 and label covariances −5/18, −2/9, 0, summing to −1/2; no execution of the frozen verifier. The deterministic last label and the n=2 degeneracy agree.

evidence: Lundblad–Wagner includes uniform recursive trees at α=0, establishes asymptotic moments for the difference between mean leaf depth and mean vertex depth, and marks size, total leaves and path statistics jointly. Saunders's equal-column-sum criterion preserves uniformity within size strata under deletion rules; its exhibited last-in-first-out example deletes the deterministic last leaf.
